WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "ordered_at" AS "ORDERED_AT",
      "amount" AS "AMOUNT"
    FROM "shop"."main"."orders"
  ),
  "menura_2_periodrange" AS (
    SELECT
      "ORDERED_AT",
      "AMOUNT"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE CAST(("ORDERED_AT") AT TIME ZONE CAST($1 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) >= CASE WHEN length(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR)) = 4 THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), 1, 1) WHEN substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'Q' THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 7, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 1) WHEN substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'W' THEN CAST(date_trunc('week', make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), 1, 4)) AS DATE) + 7 * (CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 7, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1) WHEN length(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR)) = 7 THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR), 6, 2) AS INTEGER), 1) ELSE CAST(CAST($2 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) END AND CAST(("ORDERED_AT") AT TIME ZONE CAST($1 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) <= CAST(CASE WHEN length(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR)) = 4 THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), 1, 1) WHEN substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'Q' THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 7, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 1) WHEN substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'W' THEN CAST(date_trunc('week', make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), 1, 4)) AS DATE) + 7 * (CAST(substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 7, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1) WHEN length(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR)) = 7 THEN make_date(CAST(substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 6, 2) AS INTEGER), 1) ELSE CAST(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) END + CASE WHEN length(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR)) = 4 THEN INTERVAL 1 YEAR WHEN substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'Q' THEN INTERVAL 3 MONTH WHEN substr(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR), 6, 1) = 'W' THEN INTERVAL 7 DAY WHEN length(CAST($3 AS VARCHAR)) = 7 THEN INTERVAL 1 MONTH ELSE INTERVAL 1 DAY END - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE)
  ),
  "menura_3_aggregate" AS (
    SELECT
      date_trunc('day', "ORDERED_AT" AT TIME ZONE CAST($1 AS VARCHAR)) AT TIME ZONE CAST($1 AS VARCHAR) AS "DAY",
      CAST(SUM("AMOUNT") FILTER (WHERE "AMOUNT" > 20) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS "LARGE_AMOUNT"
    FROM "menura_2_periodrange"
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  "menura_4_project" AS (
    SELECT
      "DAY" AS "day_start",
      "LARGE_AMOUNT" AS "large_amount"
    FROM "menura_3_aggregate"
  )
SELECT
  "day_start",
  "large_amount"
FROM "menura_4_project"
